biography: Results-focused, detail-oriented, safety conscientious team leader/player. Experience combining operations, project and facility management. Data Center Technology Engineer with more than 25 years of experience in Data Center Systems and Telecommunications Technology, encompassing expertise in management, installation, rehabilitation, and maintenance of data center systems and telecommunications technology. Expertise in the monitoring, preventive, predictive, planned, and corrective maintenance of critical systems directly related to service delivery for data center operations and long-haul networks. Areas of expertise include: • Excellent communication skills in management. • Negotiating and directing construction activities,including validating on-going expenses and supervising construction activities. • Lead overall end-to-end project delivery including resources,OPEX,RFP, RFI, RFQ, CAPEX, schedule and vendor management. • Capacity planning and monitoring facility activities to include electrical, HVAC, UPS, PDU’s, Generators and associated infrastructure maintenance and installation. • Management, design and implementation of Data Center expansions and new builds. • Military veteran with a global understanding and experience working with diverse cultures in different regions. Bi-lingual (English /Greek). • Management, design and implementation of OSP, ISP paired-copper wire, optical fiber strands, coaxial communications and data cables in support of switching/distribution systems and long haul fiber. Management and design of security camera design layout, access security and environmental controls. • Knowledge of DWDM, OTN, Gig Ethernet, SONET, SDH, FTTP, GPON. • Acceptance testing and troubleshooting OTDR, TIA 568C.2, SONET, SDH, BERT, RFC-2544. • Extensive knowledge of industry Best Practices, Business Management, Project Management methodology, and Operations Science analytical/statistical processes.
